sections.description: The core bridge between Exacoat Manager ERP, WooCommerce orders, custom status, and fulfillment tracking.
sections.changelog:
### Version 0.1.42
- Resolved "Valid product_id is required" error when editing MacBook Pro and MacBook Air devices by guaranteeing product_id and device identity in configurator REST endpoints and Studio editor
- Resolved base price IDR 0 display on laptops and variable products by retrieving true WooCommerce prices and variation price fallbacks
- Guarded product saving to prevent unintentional zero-price overwrites on WooCommerce products
